instruction: You're facing towards the wall, turn slightly towards your left, enter the room, you'll enter in to bedroom, go few steps forward, then turn left, go near the door, turn left, and exit the room, to the left you'll find flower pot, and mirror, go straight, to the right you'll find frame, go straight, again to the left you'll find flower pot, and mirror, go few steps forward, and enter the room, you'll enter in to living room, at the end of the room near the door, beside two white color chairs you'll find your destination.
